title: Bond-eye Australia, Gurney's Montauk Team Up
text:
In honor of Gurney's Montauk's centennial anniversary, the luxury Hamptons beach hotel and spa has partnered with Bond-Eye Australia on a special, limited-edition capsule collection of swim and fashions.
“Celebrating Gurney’s 100th anniversary is about honoring our legacy while creating new traditions for today’s travelers,” Michael Nenner, president and chief operating officer of Gurney’s Resorts, told WWD.
He added the company’s partnership with Bond-eye Australia will kick off with a private Atlantic oceanfront yoga session led by Kat Ruiz for invited creators, media and special guests on the venue’s fitness deck. The celebratory weekend July 11 and 12 also will be filled with activations spanning from a beachside retail experience and sunset happy hours to immersive beach activities that allow guests to embrace the Montauk lifestyle, he said.
“It’s a celebration of wellness, community, and the effortless luxury that has defined Gurney’s for a century. ”The beachside retail cabana, curated by Bond-Eye, will feature the duo’s exclusive collaborative capsule collection, made up of swim and ready-to-wear styles, as well as a selection of the Australian brand’s signature swim and resortwear.
“Our partnership with Gurney’s was a natural fit because both brands celebrate an elevated coastal lifestyle. We share values rooted in effortless luxury, relaxation, and creating meaningful summer experiences, all while inspiring a sense of escape through timeless design,” Steve Philpott, founder and chief executive officer of Bond-eye Australia, told WWD.
“It’s an honor and a privilege to align with such a highly respected Montauk institution known and enjoyed by so many to celebrate their 100consists of six swim styles, including one-piece maillots and bikinis crafted in the brand’s signature Authentic Crinkle fabric and handmade in Australia — knitted using premium recycled fibers and engineered with four-way stretch. The ready-to-wear includes classic styles suitable for everyday wear, including a quarter-zip, long-sleeve, T, hat and towel.
The assortment, priced $100 to $235 for swim and $75 to $175 for rtw and accessories, will be available exclusively at Gurney’s, on thein New York City and Los Angeles. Philpott noted these global expansions, including one on Astir Beach in Athens, Greece, that opened in June offers customers an immersive retail experience that brings the brand’s ethos to life.
“From the beginning, this felt like a very authentic partnership. Gurney’s and Bond-eye both celebrate a relaxed yet elevated coastal lifestyle rooted in quality, design, and community,” Nenner said.
“As we mark our centennial year, we wanted to collaborate with a brand that shares our passion for creating meaningful experiences rather than simply showcasing products. Together, we’ve created a weekend that captures the spirit of summer in Montauk and reflects what both of our brands do best — bringing people together in unforgettable settings by the water. ”WWD and Women's Wear Daily are part of Penske Media Corporation. © 2026 Fairchild Publishing, LLC.
